name: Portuguese canned sardines
where: Conserveira de Lisboa, Rua dos Bacalhoeiros
about: Canned sardines are a classic Portuguese food, and this Lisbon shop has been around for generations. They make a practical take-home gift.
tip: Choose by fish type and oil preference rather than by the label design.

name: Azulejo ceramic tile
about: Azulejos are hand-painted glazed tiles that decorate buildings and homes across Portugal. They are a defining part of Lisbon's look.
tip: Avoid antique tiles of unclear origin, since some may come from demolished buildings.

name: Portuguese cork wallet
about: Cork crafting is a Portuguese tradition, and the material is soft, light, and water-resistant. Lisbon shops sell many cork goods.
tip: Check the lining and the glue finish at the edges before buying.
